description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a national fast food chain specializing in Southern-style fried chicken, located on Bridgeport Road in Richmond. This location is halal-certified according to OSM tags, which may be relevant to some touring cyclists. It offers takeout service and is situated in a commercial area of Richmond.
